title: Gebruik van autogordels 1970-1973
authors: Instituut voor sociaal-wetenschappelijk en economisch onderzoek, ISEO * Bussum (primary investigator)
descriptions: Data on use or non-use of safety-belts among motorists / attitude towards use of safety-belts and knowledge of their effectiveness / effects of information program by Veilig Verkeer Nederland and legal obligation of use of safety-belts. Background variables: basic characteristics/ residence/ household characteristics/ occupation/employment/ education/ social class/ consumption of durables
